# Fair Play

Nobody gets to describe another player's character, their boundaries, or their
motives without their say-so. The table agrees to this before the first session
and the agreement is not revisited mid-arc.

Lines are played in the open. A line that is uncomfortable is still a line the
group agreed to hear.
